summary: Pure refactor of the @cipherstash/cli package: user-facing strings that E2E tests assert on are moved into a new `src/messages.ts` const object, and the CLI entrypoint, `auth` command and `selectRegion()` prompt now interpolate those constants. Every extracted constant reproduces the previous literal byte-for-byte (including the ': ' composition for unknown-command errors), so rendered CLI output is unchanged. The new module is bundled by tsup into dist/bin/stash.js, adds no dependency and is not exported from the library entry. E2E tests import the same constants; the `db migrate` assertion is tightened from a substring to the full message. CI 'Run Tests' (which builds and runs the CLI E2E suite) passed on head. No material failure scenario identified.

behaviour_changes.description: CLI help banner, usage lines, unknown command/subcommand errors, db migrate stub warning, region prompt and cancel message are now built from constants in src/messages.ts. The resulting strings are identical to the base literals; no user-visible output change.

E2E smoke and auth-cancel tests assert using the shared constants instead of literals. The db-migrate test now asserts the full warning text instead of the 'not yet implemented' fragment. Copy changes made in messages.ts will no longer be caught by these tests (intended design).
packages/cli/AGENTS.md documents the messages.ts convention; the file is not in the package's published `files` list.
